summary: The user clarified that LS should develop personal goal-directed cognitive gardens rather than a general cognitive network. The user emphasized that each person should own and grow their own cognitive graph, cultivated by connected agents and sessions.
source_signals: The user described a personal graph that every connected agent can help cultivate.
The user explicitly connected the idea to human development, corporate development, and commercial value.
The user rejected framing LS as a generic shared cognitive network.
